name: auth-form-layout
title: Auth form layout
description: The credentials panel: a header slot, a compact brand header on mobile, the title and description, the form, and rows beneath it.

when: The form side of an auth screen.

builtIn: The title is the page's h1.
youProvide: A title that names the task ("Sign in").

AuthFormLayout.name: surface
AuthFormLayout.description:
`card` (default) raises the panel onto its own surface; `plain` lets it sit
directly on the pane. The default matches the busiest existing screen.

AuthFormLayout.name: titleClassName
AuthFormLayout.description:
The heading's type style, a DS heading class: `text-heading-large` by default; a screen with a longer title
may step down (`text-heading-medium`).

AuthFormLayout.name: headerSlot
AuthFormLayout.description: Above everything, at the inline end — a language switcher, a back link.

AuthFormLayout.name: logoSlot
AuthFormLayout.description: The compact brand header, mobile only: the brand pane is desktop-only.

AuthFormLayout.name: footerSlot
AuthFormLayout.description: Under the body — a secondary route out of the screen.

AuthFormLayout.name: noticeSlot
AuthFormLayout.description: Last, set apart — legal text, a support line.

AuthFormLayout.name: bodyClassName
AuthFormLayout.description:
The spacing between the form's rows (`space-y-4` by default), merged onto a native form child. The DS `Form`
takes no className and keeps its own gap, so this has no effect on it.

AuthFormLayout.name: children
AuthFormLayout.description:
A single element — the screen's own form. The layout renders the body
region *through* it, so it keeps its element, its handler and its
attributes while the rhythm arrives from here.

A form component (rather than a `<form>`) must pass `className` and
`data-slot` on to its element, or the rhythm is lost.
